newsitem.title: UK: Mirror denies Newspaper Publishing sales talk.
newsitem.headline: Mirror denies Newspaper Publishing sales talk.

text.p: Mirror Group dismissed speculation on Friday that it would sell its 46 percent stake in Newspaper Publishing to Ireland's Independent Newspapers Plc, the other main shareholder in the company.
"There is no evidence to suggestion that this is going on," a Mirror Group spokesman said. Loss-making Newspaper Publishing produces Britain's lndependent and Independent on Sunday titles.

Tony O'Reilly's Independent Newspapers also owns 46 percent of the company. A report in the Guardian newspaper this week said that O'Reilly had offered 60 million stg to buy out the Mirror Group's stake.
"Tony O"Reilly was in London this week but this was part of the normal round of budget meetings," the Mirror spokesman said.
